result.summary: Review of target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930), scope: token accounting/progress/excerpt sanitation, cumulative vs per-run usage, misleading inference counts. Verdict FINDINGS: 4 defects, 2 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM, all reproduced with local fake providers in /tmp. HIGH: excerpt redaction in src/security.ts:97 is bypassed by 13 terminal-invisible code points (U+200B et al.) that are stripped AFTER redact(), rejoining a split secret - get_worker served a worker's own OpenCode server_password and the configured model API key intact. HIGH: src/coordinator.ts:425/430/490/498 skip this.inference/this.excerpts cleanup, so swarmforge_inference_requests_active and get_swarm_status.inference_requests_active stay inflated forever and a failed worker still serves an excerpt, contradicting docs/MCP-API.md:8. MEDIUM: src/metrics.ts:95 labels every token row with the configured model, discarding usage.model. MEDIUM (code-evidenced): src/coordinator.ts:638 keys the excerpt on one dispatch, so a cancelled-then-requeued turn can hide or misattribute live text. Existing targeted suites all pass (42/42 across token-idle, excerpt, session-status, core; 18/18 overview, api). No source changes made; /workspace/repo untouched on baseline 5672ead and clean.
result.details:
Setup: disposable detached clone /tmp/rev30/repo verified at the exact target with git rev-parse HEAD. Official Bun 1.4.2 installed under /tmp/rev30/bun142; bun install --frozen-lockfile run only in the clone; the lockfile was never rewritten. No cloud, model-provider or VM calls: all probes used the repo's FakeProvider/FakeAgent and a stubbed fetch.

F1 HIGH src/security.ts:97 (via src/coordinator.ts:651). excerptText redacts first and strips invisibles second (line 107), so a secret split by U+200B (and 12 other code points: U+200C, U+200D, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+0001, U+0007, U+001F, U+0085, U+0091, U+009B, U+2028, U+202E, U+2060) defeats replaceAll and is then reassembled into plaintext by get_worker. Reproduced end to end for the worker's own server_password and both configured API tokens. Existing test tests/excerpt.test.ts:91-110 only checks direct containment and control stripping; an ANSI-split secret correctly becomes 'model- secret' (ESC -> space), which is why nothing catches this. Fix: strip invisibles before redacting.

F2 HIGH src/coordinator.ts:425, 430, 490, 498. Four transitions to paused / recovery_required / failed omit this.inference.delete and this.excerpts.delete, unlike the guarded paths at 408-411, 849-850, 892-893, 966-967. runTick reconciles before stepping (308-314), so stopped/paused guests are reconciled into states that are never re-inspected and the stale value is permanent: the gauge read 1 after 5 further tick+recover cycles in recovery_required and paused, and step()'s lost-guest path served an excerpt for a failed worker. Control case control(id,'pause') clears both maps, proving the invariant is intended. Also unbounded Map growth. No existing test asserts the gauge or excerpt after these transitions.

F3 MEDIUM src/metrics.ts:95. store.tokens() sums directions without GROUP BY model (src/store.ts:328) and render labels every row model=SWARMFORGE_MODEL_NAME; usage.model (src/store.ts:30) is written and never read, so the {team,model,direction} breakdown in docs/OBSERVABILITY.md:16 is not produced. Reproduced: a row stored under aux-model rendered as model="qwen".

F4 MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:638 (code-evidenced, medium confidence). trackExcerpt and the token-progress baseline key on the single dispatch returned by store.dispatch(); if a follow-up is enqueued and the earlier dispatch cancelled, messages for the still-streaming dispatch are ignored and the excerpt is deleted (line 643), or superseded text can be shown as current. Related guard at tests/excerpt.test.ts:204-212 covers only the case it sets up directly.

Tests: bun test tests/token-idle.test.ts tests/excerpt.test.ts -> 20 pass/0 fail; adding tests/session-status.test.ts tests/core.test.ts -> 42 pass/0 fail, 162 assertions; bun test tests/overview.test.ts tests/api.test.ts -> 18 pass/0 fail. Reviewer probes in /tmp/rev30/probe: confirm.test.ts 0/6, inv.test.ts 1/1 fail, recoverfirst.test.ts 0/3 fail, persist.test.ts 3 pass/1 fail, reach.test.ts 1 pass/1 fail - every failure is a reproduction of a finding. Logs under /workspace/.swarmforge/logs.

Limitations: F4 not reproduced end to end; F3 simulates a differing modelID at the store boundary; F1 severity assumes the guest can read its own exported OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD (src/providers/freestyle.ts:153), not confirmed with a booted guest. Full suite and packaging not run (out of scope). Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.

result.followup_reason: Four actionable defects in the reviewed scope: two HIGH (excerpt redaction bypass via invisible code points; uncleared inference/excerpt maps on reconcile and poll-time settle paths) and two MEDIUM (metrics model label discards usage.model; single-dispatch excerpt keying). All reproduced locally with fake providers.
